copy.tagline: 自动完成 Agentql 上的重复任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Agentql 上执行重复操作
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often perform repetitive operations on Agentql

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 调用 Agentql 工具，自动完成网页数据提取、表单填写等任务。使用前需先搜索工具并检查连接状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行 Agentql 相关自动化操作（如网页抓取、表单操作）时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Agentql 提取这个页面的所有产品名称和价格。
say.note: Claude 会搜索可用工具并执行提取。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can automate Agentql tasks via Rube MCP, such as scraping web data or filling forms. It always searches for tools and checks the connection first.
howto.when_en: When the user asks Claude to perform Agentql-related automation, like web scraping or form operations.

say_en.text: Use Agentql to extract all product names and prices from this page.
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and perform extraction.

say_en.text: Automate login form with username admin and password 123456 using Agentql.
say_en.note: Claude will call the appropriate tool.
